overview.description: The Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF (HYPG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long hype, short usd currency. The fund is solely and passively invested indirectly in HYPE. The investment objective of the fund is to reflect the value of HYPE plus earned staking consideration, less expenses and other liabilities HYPG was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Grayscale.
